answer: To join, a newcomer burns an umber-marked deposit that is forfeited on failed verification, while legitimate agents accumulate a jade reputation token that unlocks larger payouts. Agents receive identity through bonded staking plus verifiable work history: each new agent must lock a minimum stake and complete tasks whose proofs are checked by randomly assigned peers. A forged plume of fake accounts becomes costly, since every duplicate identity requires fresh capital at risk, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
